name: Black Bear Diner Slow-Cooked Pot Roast with Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (American Fork / Sandy, UT)
whyItWorks: Tender beef chuck roast slow-braised until fork-tender and served in savory brown beef gravy over smooth mashed potatoes. Low in fiber and highly comforting.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for extra tender meat and smooth mashed potatoes with light brown gravy. Skip whole baby carrots or green beans if adhering to strict low-residue.
